text:
mira (sec-eng): Heads-up: alerts from CloudTrail -> ELK show logpipe service failing to write KMS audit blobs to s3://kms-audit-prod starting ~03:14 UTC after RBAC tighten. 403s on PutObject and PutObjectAcl.

dev (runtime): Which principal? role or instance profile?

mira (sec-eng): AssumedRole arn:aws:sts::222222:assumed-role/logpipe-writer-prod/i-0def456. Error: AccessDenied on PutObjectAcl.

lee (infra): I deployed the RBAC prune at 03:05 to remove legacy cross-account grants. I scoped down a couple of roles; didn't think logpipe-writer was affected. Pasting CI diff: 
```
- "Principal": {"AWS": "arn:aws:iam::222222:role/logpipe-writer-prod"},
+ (removed)
```

tara (compliance): Please DO NOT mutate policies until we snapshot the key policy + bucket ACLs. Need to preserve forensic trail for the audit.

mira (sec-eng): Already grabbed CloudTrail entries and S3 access logs for the 02:50-03:30 window and put them in the incident folder. But we should capture the KMS key policy and bucket policy now.

ci-bot: terraform plan triggered by lee on infra/rbac at 2026-03-21T03:04:58Z -> applied 03:05:12Z

dev (runtime): I can run a write test as the role once perms are back. Also saw the re-encrypt job terminated with EACCES in the same timeframe. Suspect two separate failure signals from the same root cause (role lost s3:PutObject and s3:PutObjectAcl).

lee (infra): Rolling back the specific line now to restore the principal grant to the bucket policy. Will add a scoped bucket policy instead of leaving a wide role grant.

build-bot: image-scan/logpipe:20260320 -> flagged CVE-2026-AB12 (OpenSSL) and CVE-2026-CD34 (glibc). Recommended: rebuild base with patched libs + cosign sign.

mira (sec-eng): Rebuilds must be gated: cosign signatures required, compliance approval required, and we should include a quick canary that performs an authenticated PutObject as logpipe-writer to validate post-deploy.

tara (compliance): Confirmed. Also requesting that any PR touching RBAC includes a checklist section listing dependent integrations (log pipelines, key-rotation jobs, backups) and an automated smoke that verifies write path.

lee (infra): Policy patch applied at 03:18 UTC, ACL restored. Verifying tailing logs...

ops-bot: s3 write success detected from arn:aws:iam::222222:role/logpipe-writer-prod at 2026-03-21T03:19:01Z

mira (sec-eng): Ingestion resumed but we lost ~20 minutes of key wrap telemetry. We need to backfill re-wraps for 02:50-03:20. dev, can you run the rewrap-backfill?

dev (runtime): Yes. I'll coordinate a maintenance window. Will also run the canary smoke in a staging account and then prod smoke after change.

mira (sec-eng): Action items we agreed on: 1) RBAC change playbook: add KMS & S3 dependent integration checklist + snapshot step; 2) add CI smoke that assumes the role and performs PutObject/PutObjectAcl; 3) add post-RBAC canary that checks log ingestion rate & key-rotation success; 4) enforce cosign + compliance signoff on any base image rebuild touching logpipe.

tara (compliance): I'll add these items to the compliance backlog and include them in next quarter's audit. Also request that we store a copy of key policy snapshots in vault-only read for sec/compliance.

lee (infra): I'll open infra#6102 to implement the smoke validation and apron the RBAC PR template to force listing of affected integrations.

mira (sec-eng): Creating incident doc KMS-AUDIT-WRITE-20260321 and adding timeline + artifacts. Please append notes and any relevant diffs.

(End of thread)
